messages.text: Root returns 500, so the wrapper is binding but the handler is throwing. I’m capturing server stderr to a local log for the exact failure.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$out='"'server-out.log'; "'$err='"'server-err.log'; Remove-Item "'$out,$err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $p = Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList @('"'scripts/serve-built.mjs','--port=3120') -WorkingDirectory 'T:\\' -RedirectStandardOutput "'$out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:3120/ -TimeoutSec 10 | Out-Null } catch {}; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Write-Output "PID=$($p.Id)"; Get-Content $out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-Content $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $kids=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ParentProcessId -eq $p.Id } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId; if($kids){ Stop-Process -Id $kids -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue'
